1  #
     2  #  In order to use the fuzzer, you must build with:
     3  #
     4  #       ./configure --enable-fuzzer ...
     5  #
     6  #  and then re-build *all* of the source.
     7  #
     8  #  Once the fuzzer is build, run it via:
     9  #
    10  #       make fuzzer.PROTOCOL
    11  #
    12
    13  #
    14  #  The libraries to be fuzzed MUST be explicitly linked to the protocol libraries.
    15  #  Dynamic loading will NOT work.  In order to simplify the process, the protocol
    16  #  libraries export a common test point.  We have one source / make file, which
    17  #  then magically turns into different fuzzers.
    18  #
    19
    20  TARGET          := fuzzer_$(PROTOCOL)
    21  SOURCES         := fuzzer.c
    22
    23  TGT_PREREQS     := libfreeradius-$(PROTOCOL).a
    24
    25  TGT_LDLIBS      := $(LIBS)
    26
    27  #
    28  #  Ensure that the large data file is copied from git-lfs,
    29  #  and then the files are extracted.
    30  #
    31  .PHONY:src/tests/fuzzer-corpus/$(PROTOCOL)
    32  src/tests/fuzzer-corpus/$(PROTOCOL):
    33          ${Q}if [ ! -e $@ ]; then \
    34                  git -c 'lfs.fetchexclude=' -c 'lfs.fetchinclude=src/tests/fuzzer-corpus/$(PROTOCOL).tar' lfs pull; \
    35                  cd src/tests/fuzzer-corpus; \
    36                  tar -xf $(PROTOCOL).tar; \
    37          fi
    38
    39  .PHONY: $(FUZZER_ARTIFACTS)/$(PROTOCOL)
    40  $(FUZZER_ARTIFACTS)/$(PROTOCOL):
    41          @mkdir -p $@
    42
    43  $(TEST_BIN_DIR)/fuzzer_$(PROTOCOL): $(BUILD_DIR)/lib/local/libfreeradius-$(PROTOCOL).la | $(FUZZER_ARTIFACTS)/$(PROTOCOL)
    44
    45  #
    46  #  Run the fuzzer binary against the fuzzer corpus data files.
    47  #
    48  #  @todo - make `max_len` protocol-specific
    49  #
    50  #  We can also add
    51  #
    52  #       -use_value_profile=1
    53  #
    54  #  This will track values across compare instructions.  But it can slow down scanning by 2x, and
    55  #  increase the size of the corpus by several times.
    56  #
    57  fuzzer.$(PROTOCOL): $(TEST_BIN_DIR)/fuzzer_$(PROTOCOL) | src/tests/fuzzer-corpus/$(PROTOCOL)
    58          ${Q}$(TEST_BIN)/fuzzer_$(PROTOCOL) \
    59                  -artifact_prefix="$(FUZZER_ARTIFACTS)/$(PROTOCOL)/" \
    60                  -max_len=512 $(FUZZER_ARGUMENTS) \
    61                  -D share/dictionary \
    62                  src/tests/fuzzer-corpus/$(PROTOCOL)
    63
    64  #
    65  #  tests add a 10s timeout.  This is so that we can see if the fuzzers run _at all_.
    66  #
    67  test.fuzzer.$(PROTOCOL): $(TEST_BIN_DIR)/fuzzer_$(PROTOCOL) | src/tests/fuzzer-corpus/$(PROTOCOL)
    68          @echo TEST-FUZZER $(PROTOCOL) for $(FUZZER_TIMEOUT)s
    69          ${Q}$(TEST_BIN)/fuzzer_$(PROTOCOL) \
    70                  -artifact_prefix="$(FUZZER_ARTIFACTS)/$(PROTOCOL)/" \
    71                  -max_len=512 $(FUZZER_ARGUMENTS) \
    72                  -max_total_time=$(FUZZER_TIMEOUT) \
    73                  -D share/dictionary \
    74                  src/tests/fuzzer-corpus/$(PROTOCOL)
#  Time out "test.fuzzer.foo" after this number of seconds
#
FUZZER_TIMEOUT   ?= 10

#
#  Define a function to do all of the same thing.
#
define FUZZ_PROTOCOL
src/bin/fuzzer_${1}.mk: src/bin/fuzzer.mk
        $${Q}sed 's/$$$$(PROTOCOL)/${1}/g' < $$^ > $$@

SUBMAKEFILES += fuzzer_${1}.mk
endef

$(foreach X,${FUZZER_PROTOCOLS},$(eval $(call FUZZ_PROTOCOL,${X})))

.PHONY: fuzzer.help
fuzzer.help:
        @git-lfs env > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo "Please install 'git-lfs' in order to use the fuzzer corpus files."
        @echo To run the fuzzer, please use one of:
        @echo
        @for _p in $(PROTOCOLS); do echo "    make fuzzer.$$_p"; done
        @echo

test.fuzzer: $(addprefix test.fuzzer.,$(FUZZER_PROTOCOLS))

else
.PHONY: fuzzer.help $(foreach X,${FUZZER_PROTOCOLS},fuzzer.${X})
fuzzer.help $(foreach X,${FUZZER_PROTOCOLS},fuzzer.${X}) test.fuzzer:
        @echo "The server MUST be built with '--enable-fuzzer'"
endif
